issues.observation: Both images select 新会话 with 0 次生成 and show 还没有图片. The required completed B attempt and its enabled refine / disabled variation controls are absent. A running badge and named return link are visible.
issues.repair_suggestion: Prepare B with a completed attempt before starting A; select and expand B, then recapture both widths. This evidence cannot establish the required busy-state action behavior.

issues.observation: The first attempt header and prompt are above the timeline viewport in wide; narrow shows only its bottom edge. Thus neither capture shows 第1次→第2次→第3次 with three complete thumbnails. Narrow also cuts off the expanded third card before its advanced disclosure and action buttons.
issues.repair_suggestion: Adjust timeline/card sizing or provide complementary viewport evidence showing the complete ordered history and selected card controls. Recalculate scroll positioning after changing viewport size; do not treat offscreen content as visually verified.

issues.observation: The expanded card extends below the timeline viewport. Refine-prefill and four-attempts omit both action buttons; switch-back shows only their top borders at the bottom edge, with no readable labels. The composer itself remains visible.
issues.repair_suggestion: Keep the selected card actions visible after resize and composer growth, for example by scrolling the action row into view or using a persistent action row. Recapture at 900×700. A screenshot does not establish whether manual scrolling would recover them.

issues.observation: Header correctly says 尚未安装图片模型，请到「资源」页下载, but the bottom status instead says 图片 MLX 运行环境缺失，请安装 .venv-image 或使用包含图片运行时的应用. Required model-download status is absent there. Generate appears disabled.
issues.repair_suggestion: Capture model-missing with runtime available and show the model-download explanation in the status line; if multiple failures coexist, make the priority explicit and add separate evidence.

issues.criteria_ref: visual-acceptance-criteria.md global forbidden seed word; visual-acceptance-criteria.json states[library-after-delete].must_not_show
issues.observation: Both library rows visibly show 种子 followed by numbers outside any expanded 高级参数. The gradient preview itself is present and unbroken. The JSON standard explicitly repeats this prohibition for library-after-delete.
issues.repair_suggestion: Move seed metadata into an expanded advanced disclosure, or obtain an explicit acceptance-standard change if the library is intended to be exempt; the current written standard does not exempt it.

issues.observation: The 已取消 badge, gray X icon and two actions are clear, but no separate cancellation explanation is visible; the repeated text 会被取消的一张 is the prompt.
issues.repair_suggestion: Add a brief explanation such as 已取消本次生成，未生成图片 below the status, preserving the existing controls.

issues.criteria_ref: visual-acceptance-criteria.md § delete-confirm: 取消获得焦点
issues.observation: Cancel has an ordinary dark button border with no discernible focus indicator in these captures. Dialog wording, danger styling and running continuation sentence are readable. Actual DOM focus cannot be established from these pixels.
issues.repair_suggestion: Give the initially focused Cancel button a clearly visible focus treatment and capture it; verify keyboard focus separately.

issues.criteria_ref: batch-A-harness.md declared mock layers; § attempt-selected-actions; § library-after-delete
issues.observation: Gradient images render at approximately 96×64, including expanded/preview images. This is consistent with the declared small PNG fixture, not a broken-image defect. Library views cannot simultaneously show the image-session sidebar; verify-after-delete provides the complementary remaining-session view.
issues.repair_suggestion: Keep fixture limitations explicit and use batch B to assess real-resolution image sizing. Do not claim model-output quality or actual-resolution preview coverage from batch A.

summary: Inspected all 48 supplied PNGs using view_image. Failed visual review: 5 major issues, 2 minor issues, 1 scope note; no missing or unreadable screenshots. Judgments use visible pixels, not DOM-check records.
